title: WORN GEAR ON THE PILLAGER
why: Answers 76, 77 and 78: gear looks belong to the piece being worn. Six visible slots now use three variants per rarity, with jewelry hidden and the fashion depot frozen. Watch: check hats, gloves and backpacks while moving, crouching and rolling in both looks.
now: Headgear, armor, pants, boots, gloves and backpacks show the worn pieces. Owned body choices stay. LOCAL: no linked review.
